trust_boundaries: Public Internet -> Ingress Layer (Tenant Users to API Gateway)
Ingress Layer -> LLM Service Layer / Data Layer (Tenant Router boundary)
LLM Service Layer -> External Model Backends (Egress to OpenAI and Anthropic)
LLM Service Layer -> Internal Data Layer (Orchestrator to VectorDB, ConversationStore, AuditLog)
architecture_summary.operational_context: Multi-tenant cloud SaaS deployment orchestrating agentic LLM context retrieval and third-party model backend integrations.

threat_actors.name: Malicious SaaS Tenant / External Attacker
threat_actors.motivation: Cross-tenant data theft, indirect prompt injection, tool hijacking, and service abuse
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Public REST API endpoints via API Gateway
non_capabilities: No direct access to cloud virtual networks or database subnets
No administrative access to Kubernetes infrastructure or secret stores
No direct source code modification rights

threat_actors.name: Compromised Context Vector / Data Poisoner
threat_actors.motivation: Poison vector embeddings to hijack LLM workflow logic and alter model output
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Document ingestion pipeline or shared VectorDB index
non_capabilities: No ability to bypass API Gateway authentication controls
No direct shell access to LLM Orchestrator nodes

attack_paths.impact: Malicious context retrieved from VectorDB overrides agent system prompts and triggers unauthorized tool execution.
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Retrieved vector content is merged into orchestrator prompts without secondary verification.

attack_paths.impact: Exploitation of weak tenant context propagation allows cross-tenant query execution against TenantDB and ConversationStore.
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Routing headers or tokens passing through TenantRouter could be forged or manipulated if scope validation fails.

attack_paths.technique_name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol: Exfiltration Over Asymmetric Encrypted Non-C2 Protocol
attack_paths.impact: Unredacted tenant PII and proprietary context are transmitted to external third-party API endpoints (OpenAI/Anthropic).
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: ModelRouter automatically redirects raw user inputs to third-party endpoints based on performance policies.

attack_paths.impact: Adversarial text embeddings injected into VectorDB alter similarity search distances, blinding RAG retrieval.
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Document ingestion APIs permit tenant uploads without semantic distance anomaly checks.

attack_paths.impact: An attacker with execution access on LLMOrchestrator suppresses or alters audit log entries to conceal exploitation activity.
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Requires compromise of orchestrator process with write privilege over the AuditLog data store.

mitigations.control_name: Dual-Layer Prompt Input/Output Sanitization and Context Boundary Enforcer
Cryptographic Tenant Isolation and Router Scope Attestation
Data Masking and Automatic PII Redaction at Model Router Egress
Vector Embedding Semantic Validation and Outlier Detection
Append-Only Immutable Audit Log Store with WORM Policies

findings.severity_rationale: Indirect prompt injection via RAG vector context allows attackers to hijack agent execution logic and perform unauthorized actions.
Potential multi-tenant scope confusion in TenantRouter could permit cross-tenant data leaks across shared database tiers.
Unmasked sensitive data egress to public LLM API backends introduces significant regulatory and confidentiality exposure.
Adversarial embedding injection in VectorDB degrades context retrieval and corrupts agent response accuracy.
Audit log modification risks are minimized by append-only policies but depend on orchestrator credential isolation.

agentic.blast_radius: Unauthorized disclosure of cross-tenant conversation logs and corrupted LLM context output across active user sessions.
human_oversight_points: Human-in-the-loop approval required for administrative database mutations
Real-time security auditing on PromptGuard and ResponseFilter flag triggers
